plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Pre-Nursing Track, Public Health, AS' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/public-health-pre-nursing-as/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Public Health Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The catalog defines its plan footnotes on this page: 1 = 'See Approved General Education list for AA/AS degree', 2 = 'See program recommendations and requirements', 3 = ENG placement note (additional 3 units become elective units) — unspecified slots are modeled as choice slots with those definitions in choice_note; see advisor. NURS 130 (Nursing Assistant, 6 units) is not required for students with current state CNA certification. Prepares students to apply for the TMCC Nursing AS degree program. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
